applescript.status: CONFIRMED — requires accessibility permission grant on first use
applescript.permission_note: First run triggers 'X wants access to control Reminders' system dialog — click Allow

list_all_lists.script: tell application "Reminders" to return name of lists

list_reminders_in_list.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "Reminders"
	set output to {}
	repeat with r in reminders of targetList
		set end of output to name of r
	end repeat
	return output
end tell

list_all_reminders_all_lists.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set output to {}
	repeat with aList in lists
		repeat with r in reminders of aList
			set end of output to (name of aList) & ": " & (name of r)
		end repeat
	end repeat
	return output
end tell

create_reminder.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "Reminders"
	set tomorrow to (current date) + 1 * days
	set newReminder to make new reminder at end of reminders of targetList with properties {name:"My Reminder", due date:tomorrow}
	return name of newReminder
end tell
create_reminder.notes: due date is optional. List name must exist.

create_reminder_full_properties.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "Reminders"
	set r to make new reminder at end of reminders of targetList with properties {name:"My Reminder", due date:(current date) + 1 * days, body:"Notes here", priority:1, flagged:true}
	return name of r
end tell
create_reminder_full_properties.notes: All writable properties: name, due date, body (notes), priority (0=none/1=high/5=medium/9=low), flagged (bool)

mark_complete.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "Reminders"
	set r to reminder "My Reminder" of targetList
	set completed of r to true
end tell

delete_reminder.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "Reminders"
	delete reminder "My Reminder" of targetList
end tell

create_list.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set newList to make new list with properties {name:"My New List"}
	return name of newList
end tell

rename_list.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "My New List"
	set name of targetList to "Renamed List"
	return name of targetList
end tell

delete_list.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	delete list "My New List"
end tell

search_reminders_by_name.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set output to {}
	repeat with aList in lists
		repeat with r in reminders of aList
			if name of r contains "search term" then
				set end of output to (name of aList) & ": " & (name of r)
			end if
		end repeat
	end repeat
	return output
end tell

get_reminder_details.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "Reminders"
	set r to reminder "My Reminder" of targetList
	set output to "name:" & name of r
	set output to output & "|completed:" & (completed of r as string)
	set output to output & "|priority:" & (priority of r as string)
	set output to output & "|flagged:" & (flagged of r as string)
	set output to output & "|dueDate:" & (due date of r as string)
	set output to output & "|body:" & body of r
	return output
end tell
get_reminder_details.notes: body = notes field. due date may be 'missing value' if not set.

set_notes_body.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "Reminders"
	set r to reminder "My Reminder" of targetList
	set body of r to "My notes here"
end tell

set_priority.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "Reminders"
	set r to reminder "My Reminder" of targetList
	set priority of r to 1
end tell

set_flagged.script:
tell application "Reminders"
	set targetList to list "Reminders"
	set r to reminder "My Reminder" of targetList
	set flagged of r to true
end tell

url_property.notes: url property does not exist on reminder objects in AppleScript. Tested and confirmed not available.

location_trigger_via_applescript.notes: alarms property is not accessible via AppleScript for Reminders. Tested live — error: Can't make alarms of reminder into type specifier. Location-based triggers must be set via the UI (Add Location button in reminder detail panel).

subtasks_via_applescript.notes: Cannot create subtasks via AppleScript. 'make new reminder at end of reminders of reminder' fails with: Can't get every reminder of reminder id. Subtasks must be created via UI: Cmd+N then Cmd+] to indent while typing the reminder name.

tags_via_applescript.notes: tags property is not accessible via AppleScript. Error: Can't make tags of reminder into type specifier. Tags must be added via UI: Edit > Tags > Add Tag… (Shift+Cmd+T).

recurrence_via_applescript.notes: recurrence property is not accessible via AppleScript even when due date is set. Error: Can't make recurrence of reminder into type specifier. Recurrence must be set via UI: click reminder > Add Date > Custom > Repeat options.

property_notes.body: This is the notes field (NOT 'notes'). Using 'notes of r' causes a type error.

known_techniques.get_reminder_count_per_list: tell application "Reminders" to count reminders of list "Reminders"
known_techniques.get_overdue_reminders:
tell application "Reminders"
	set output to {}
	set now to current date
	repeat with aList in lists
		repeat with r in reminders of aList
			if (completed of r is false) and (due date of r is not missing value) and (due date of r < now) then
				set end of output to name of r
			end if
		end repeat
	end repeat
	return output
end tell
known_techniques.get_all_flagged:
tell application "Reminders"
	set output to {}
	repeat with aList in lists
		repeat with r in reminders of aList
			if flagged of r is true then
				set end of output to name of r
			end if
		end repeat
	end repeat
	return output
end tell
known_techniques.move_reminder_to_list:
tell application "Reminders"
	set r to reminder "My Reminder" of list "Reminders"
	move r to list "Another List"
end tell
known_techniques.count_all_incomplete:
tell application "Reminders"
	set total to 0
	repeat with aList in lists
		repeat with r in reminders of aList
			if completed of r is false then set total to total + 1
		end repeat
	end repeat
	return total
end tell
known_techniques.navigate_to_list_via_click_text: Use mcp__screenhand__click_text with windowId for Reminders window (get from windows() tool) and text matching the list name in sidebar. Use prefer: 'leftmost' for sidebar items.

errors.error: Can't make notes of reminder into type specifier (-1700)
errors.cause: Using 'notes of r' — wrong property name
errors.fix: Use 'body of r' instead — that is the correct property for reminder notes

errors.error: spawnSync /bin/sh ETIMEDOUT on first applescript call
errors.cause: macOS shows permission dialog for the first automation attempt. The bridge times out waiting.
errors.fix: Click Allow on the system dialog, then retry. Subsequent calls will work immediately.

errors.error: url property not found on reminder object
errors.cause: Reminders AppleScript dictionary does not expose a url property
errors.fix: url is NOT available via AppleScript. It exists in the data model but not exposed.

errors.error: Can't make alarms of reminder into type specifier
errors.cause: alarms property is not exposed via AppleScript
errors.fix: Location and time-based alarms must be set via UI (Add Date / Add Location in reminder detail panel)

errors.error: Can't make tags of reminder into type specifier
errors.cause: tags property is not exposed via AppleScript
errors.fix: Add tags via UI: click reminder > Add Tags, or Edit > Tags > Add Tag… (Shift+Cmd+T)

errors.error: Can't make recurrence of reminder into type specifier
errors.cause: recurrence property is not exposed via AppleScript even when due date is set
errors.fix: Set recurrence via UI: click reminder > Add Date > Custom… > Repeat options

errors.error: Can't get every reminder of reminder id
errors.cause: Attempting to create subtasks via AppleScript: 'make new reminder at end of reminders of reminder'
errors.fix: Subtasks cannot be created via AppleScript. Use UI: Cmd+N to create reminder, then Cmd+] to indent while typing the name.

errors.error: File menu items (Pin List, Share List, Save as Template, New Section, as List, as Columns) all appear disabled
errors.cause: These are context-sensitive items that only enable when a regular list is selected in the sidebar. They are disabled when a smart list (Today/Scheduled/All/Flagged/Completed) is active.
errors.fix: Navigate to a regular list by clicking its name in the sidebar (use click_text with the Reminders window ID)
